transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Yeah… thanks for seeing me. It’s probably not a huge thing, but for the last few weeks I just haven’t really had much of an appetite. Even stuff I usually like after work, I’ll get it and then it kind of just sits there, and I have to make myself take a few bites. I figured I should maybe get it checked out, if that makes sense.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah… I guess so. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but most days there’s this kind of heavy, flat feeling I’m carrying around. Like even when I’m home with my family, or just sitting in the break room at work, I’m there, but I don’t really feel there, if that makes sense.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… a little, I guess. I mean, I used to really look forward to my morning runs, messing around on guitar, making dinner, stuff like that. Lately I keep skipping them, not because I don’t have time exactly, but they just feel like chores I can’t quite make myself care about. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time this started?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t know if I should call it “stressful” exactly, but it did kind of line up with work changing things around. About three weeks ago the casino reorganized our security operations and changed my assignments. It’s not like anything terrible happened, but that’s when I noticed all this starting, I guess.
When you think about how you've been feeling, does it seem mostly connected to the changes at work?

Yeah… I think mostly, yes. I don’t want to blame work for everything, but it’s been about three weeks, and that’s right when the casino reorganized security and changed my assignments. So… it seems connected, at least timing-wise.
If the work changes were reversed tomorrow, do you think your mood would mostly go back to normal?

I’d like to think so, yeah. I mean, this has really only been going on about three weeks, since they reorganized security at the casino and changed my assignments. So if that got undone… maybe I’d mostly feel like myself again? I’m not totally sure, but that seems right.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work or at home?

A little, yeah… I mean, I’m still going in, still doing the basics, so I don’t want to make it sound like I’m falling apart or anything. But at work I’ve made some documentation mistakes, and I missed a surveillance cue once… and I got a formal warning, which is not normal for me. So, yeah, I guess it is starting to affect my job more than I’d like to admit.
Have you been avoiding food because you’re worried about your weight or body shape?

No, not because of weight or how I look or anything like that. I mean… I’m not trying to diet. It’s more like I just don’t feel hungry. Even stuff I usually want after a shift, I’ll get it and then it just kind of sits there, and I force down a few bites. That’s okay to say, right? It’s just not really about body shape.
Have you been feeling especially anxious or on edge lately?
I don’t know if I’d call it especially anxious. Maybe a little keyed up sometimes, but… I’m not sure. It doesn’t feel like the main thing, if that makes sense. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
If you had a day away from work, would the heavy, flat feeling still be there?

Yeah… I think it would. I mean, work doesn’t help, but it’s not just work. Most days there’s this kind of heavy, flat feeling that follows me around, even if I’m just at home with my family or sitting in the break room. I’m there, but I don’t really feel… there, if that makes sense.
Do these changes at work feel more upsetting to you than you’d normally expect them to?

I’m not totally sure. I mean, they bother me some, but I don’t know if it’s more than what someone would normally feel, you know? I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is. It’s just… noticeable, I guess. Is that what you’re asking?
Have these changes at work been causing you a lot of distress?

I wouldn’t say a lot, exactly. I mean, it’s not nothing, but I don’t want to make it sound like I’m falling apart over it. It’s more like… it weighs on me some days, and I notice it, but I’m not sure if I’d call it a lot of distress. Does that answer it the right way?
Have you been feeling hopeless lately?

I don’t know if I’d call it hopeless exactly… I mean, maybe sometimes it feels that way. Most days it’s more like I’m carrying this heavy, flat feeling around. Even when I’m home with my family or sitting in the break room, I’m kind of there but not really there. If that makes sense.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

Worthless… I don’t know. I wouldn’t want to put it that strongly. I mean, I have moments where I’m not feeling great about myself, sure, but “worthless” sounds pretty severe. I’m not sure I’d say that fits exactly. Is that okay to say?
For the past two weeks, have you felt this heavy, flat mood nearly every day?

Yeah… I think most days, yes. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but that heavy, flat feeling has been around a lot. Like I’m at home with my family or sitting at work in the break room, and I’m there, but I don’t really feel fully there. Does that count as nearly every day?
Lately, have you been having trouble concentrating?

A little, yeah. I mean, not all the time, but I’ve noticed it at work. When I’m watching the CCTV feeds or trying to write up incident reports, my mind kind of wanders, and then I have to reread what I wrote a few times. I’ve made a couple mistakes I normally wouldn’t, which is… embarrassing, I guess. But it’s not like I can’t function or anything. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

Sleeping… I’m not totally sure. I mean, I wouldn’t say it’s been a major problem. Some nights I toss around a bit or wake up and think too much, but I don’t know if that’s unusual, you know? I still get some sleep. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking about?
Have you had any thoughts that you’d be better off dead?

I mean… not like I’m going to do anything to myself. I don’t want you to think that. But… yeah, sometimes I’ve had this thought like, if I didn’t wake up, maybe that wouldn’t be the worst thing. Just not having to keep pushing through it all, I guess. Does that… is that what you mean?
Lately, have other people noticed that you’re moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah… a little, I guess. I don’t think it’s anything too dramatic, but at work a couple people have kind of noticed. Like in briefings, I’m slower getting moving, and when someone asks me something, it takes me longer to answer than it should. It feels like my body and my mouth are both, I don’t know, a step behind everybody else. Is that the sort of thing you mean?
Have you had any times lately when you felt unusually energized or high?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had moments where I try to push myself to get through work or act more upbeat, but not like unusually energized or high. Nothing that really stands out that way. Is that what you mean?
